records.original_english_definition: A person's name written in their own handwriting.
records.original_burmese_meaning: လက်မှတ်ရေးထိုးချက်
records.original_example_sentence: Please add your signature at the bottom of the form.
records.source_supported_observation: The frozen noun denotes a handwritten name on a document. Cambridge indexed English entry marks precisely the NAME noun sense B1, not C1; independent reviewer must adjudicate the C1 draft and preserve quota by selecting an appropriate independently verified candidate if relevelled.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: စာရွက်စာတမ်းပေါ်တွင် မိမိလက်ရေးဖြင့် ရေးထိုးထားသော လက်မှတ်
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: Please put your signature at the bottom of the application form.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Is the handwritten-name noun sense B1 rather than frozen C1? Obtain a directly inspected publisher CEFR receipt and fluent Myanmar signoff.

records.original_english_definition: To improve something by replacing it with a newer or better version.
records.original_burmese_meaning: အဆင့်မြှင့်တင်သည်
records.original_example_sentence: We will upgrade the software next month.
records.source_supported_observation: The frozen verb denotes improving a software or equipment version. Cambridge indexed English entry labels the improve-quality/usefulness verb B2. Do not borrow the noun upgrade or better-seat sense. The original example is grammatical.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: ဆော့ဖ်ဝဲ သို့မဟုတ် စက်ပစ္စည်းကို ပိုမိုကောင်းမွန်သော အဆင့်သို့ မြှင့်တင်သည်
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: The IT team will upgrade the software before the next training session.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Independently confirm exact improve-software verb sense and B2 vs C1.

records.original_english_definition: Including people or things of many different types.
records.original_example_sentence: The conference brought together a diverse group of researchers.
records.source_supported_observation: The frozen adjective describes a group of different types of researchers. Cambridge indexed English entry labels the many-different-types adjective B2. It does not mean a single person is inherently unusual. The original example is grammatical.
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: The programme welcomed a diverse group of learners from different backgrounds.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Independently verify B2 vs C1 for the many-types adjective sense and idiomatic Myanmar.

records.original_burmese_meaning: အသေအချာ၊ အနီးကပ်
records.original_example_sentence: The engineer examined the drawing closely.
records.source_supported_observation: The frozen adverb in examined the drawing closely means with careful attention to details, not merely physical proximity. Cambridge indexed English entry labels this CAREFULLY sense C1. The original example is grammatical.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: အသေးစိတ်ကို ဂရုတစိုက်၊ သေချာစွာ
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: The engineer examined the measurements closely before approving the design.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Independently resolve the CAREFULLY adverb sense C1 vs frozen B2; do not confuse the NEAR sense.

records.original_english_definition: Not supporting either side in a disagreement.
records.original_burmese_meaning: ဘက်မလိုက်သော
records.original_example_sentence: The mediator remained neutral during the talks.
records.source_supported_observation: The frozen adjective denotes not supporting either side of a disagreement. Cambridge indexed English entry marks the NO OPINION adjective sense C1. This is distinct from neutral colours and chemical neutrality; no independent human signoff exists.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: အငြင်းပွားမှုတွင် မည်သည့်ဘက်ကိုမျှ မထောက်ခံသော
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: The mediator remained neutral throughout the disagreement.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Independently confirm the NO OPINION C1 sense, example grammar and Myanmar translation.

records.original_english_definition: Something valuable or useful that a person or organisation owns or has.
records.original_burmese_meaning: ပိုင်ဆိုင်မှု၊ တန်ဖိုးရှိသောအရာ
records.original_example_sentence: Reliable staff are an important asset to the company.
records.source_supported_observation: The frozen example says reliable staff are an asset, matching Cambridge indexed GOOD QUALITY/useful-person noun sense C1. Do not mislabel the example as the business/accounting sense of owned assets. Burmese gloss currently includes property and value and could be made more person-specific.
records.suggested_myanmar_UNAPPROVED: အဖွဲ့အတွက် အလွန်အကျိုးရှိသော လူ သို့မဟုတ် အရည်အချင်း
records.suggested_example_UNAPPROVED: Her knowledge of both languages is a valuable asset to the team.
records.independent_reviewer_question: Independently confirm C1 GOOD QUALITY/useful-person sense and distinguish it from balance-sheet assets.
